description: This file defines a Debug class within the Opencart catalog controller namespace. It provides methods to log the execution time of routes during debugging, utilizing session data and logging functionalities.
external_files: Opencart	ype or Controller, System	ype or Engine

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class for debugging, capable of measuring execution time of routes before and after their execution.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Records the start time of a route execution and stores it in session data.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates the route execution time, logs it, and clears the debug session data.
